findings.highlight: Just as they exit the forest
findings.evidenceJa: その前に、一つの話があった。
findings.governingReading: Before that, there was one matter to relate.
findings.explanation: mirror moon begins immediately with the forest exit and drops the transition announcing that the chronology is moving back to an earlier event.

findings.highlight: There is only ‘one’ of the pendant
findings.evidenceJa: 一つしかないものなの
findings.governingReading: It is the only one of that pendant in existence.
findings.explanation: The crucial singularity of Rin’s pendant is expressed in malformed count grammar.

findings.highlight: he does not inquire about it.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼も深くは追及しない。
findings.governingReading: he does not pursue the matter deeply.
findings.explanation: The English turns Shirou’s decision not to press deeply into no inquiry at all.

findings.highlight: The tall church can be seen
findings.evidenceJa: 高い教会の屋根が見えた。
findings.governingReading: the high roof of the church came into view
findings.explanation: The visible landmark is specifically the church roof, not the entire tall building.

findings.highlight: in the horizon
findings.evidenceJa: 見上げた空の端に
findings.governingReading: at the edge of the sky he looked up toward
findings.explanation: The elevated roof’s position at the edge of the viewed sky is flattened onto the horizon.

findings.highlight: We will use that opening to attack Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺と遠坂はキャスターたちと対決する。
findings.governingReading: Rin and Shirou will confront Caster and her side.
findings.explanation: A confrontation with Caster’s group, including Kuzuki, narrows to a direct attack on Caster alone.

findings.highlight: She didn’t tell us even when we asked
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が訊いてもランサーが茶化しても教えてくれなかった
findings.governingReading: She would not explain when Shirou asked or when Lancer teased her.
findings.explanation: Distinct actions by Shirou and Lancer become a joint request, erasing Lancer’s teasing role.

findings.highlight: fulfill Tohsaka’s demand
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の要望を叶える
findings.governingReading: fulfill Tohsaka’s request
findings.explanation: Rin’s stated request becomes a coercive demand.

findings.highlight: Magic beyond one’s ability
findings.evidenceJa: 分不相応の魔術
findings.governingReading: magecraft beyond the practitioner’s proper capacity or station
findings.explanation: A technical warning about magecraft disproportionate to its user is flattened into generic “magic” and ability.

findings.highlight: is easily activated now.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識するだけでここまで手に取る事ができる。
findings.governingReading: can now be grasped and handled this readily through consciousness alone
findings.explanation: Shirou’s new degree of conscious access and control becomes mere activation.

findings.highlight: has become my primary weapon.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ一つの戦力になっている。
findings.governingReading: has become his one and only combat asset
findings.explanation: The absolute fact that Projection is Shirou’s sole fighting resource becomes only a ranking as his primary weapon.

findings.highlight: My sword technique has improved as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣の握り方、振るい方まで上達した。
findings.governingReading: even his way of gripping and wielding a sword has improved
findings.explanation: Specific embodied improvements in grip and swing become generic sword technique.

findings.highlight: An impure gray sky.
findings.evidenceJa: 濁った乳色の空。
findings.governingReading: A cloudy, muddied milk-colored sky.
findings.explanation: The unusual milky color image becomes ordinary gray, while “impure” moralizes the visual description.

findings.highlight: Beneath it stands that man.
findings.evidenceJa: 雨上がりの匂いを含んだ空
findings.governingReading: the sky carried the smell left after rain
findings.explanation: The sensory contradiction of an overcast sky already smelling of rain’s aftermath disappears.

findings.highlight: He stares at her with cool eyes.
findings.evidenceJa: 涼しげに遠坂を見つめる。
findings.governingReading: He regards Rin with an unruffled, cool manner.
findings.explanation: Archer’s composed bearing is relocated into the temperature or affect of his eyes.

findings.highlight: I’ll make it easy so you don’t have to think about it.
findings.evidenceJa: 考える手間を省いてやる
findings.governingReading: I will spare you the trouble of thinking.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s compact threat to settle the question through combat becomes vague helpfulness.

findings.highlight: the intent to kill, with Lancer’s sharp and Archer’s calm
findings.evidenceJa: 刃物のようなランサーの殺気と、それを平然と受け止めるアーチャーの殺気
findings.governingReading: Lancer’s blade-like killing intent and Archer’s killing intent calmly receiving it
findings.explanation: The opposed qualities and Archer’s active reception collapse into an ungrammatical fragment.

findings.highlight: I need him to crawl and beg your forgiveness.
findings.evidenceJa: アイツには土下座して、おまえに謝ってもらわなくちゃいけねえ
findings.governingReading: I need to make him prostrate himself and apologize to you.
findings.explanation: The culturally exact image of Archer apologizing from full prostration becomes crawling and begging.

findings.highlight: The guard, Archer, lets us through unchallenged. No, he has to let us through.
findings.evidenceJa: 門番であるアーチャーは俺たちをあっさりと通した。いや、通さざるを得なかった。
findings.governingReading: Archer, acting as gatekeeper, lets them pass easily—or rather, is forced to do so.
findings.explanation: “Unchallenged” frames passage as permission before the correction, weakening the tactical compulsion imposed by Lancer.

findings.highlight: if he lets us distract him
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちに意識をさけば
findings.governingReading: if he allocates any of his attention to them
findings.explanation: Archer’s deliberate allocation of attention becomes something Shirou and Rin passively cause.

findings.highlight: She’s a great Master
findings.evidenceJa: 少しばかり眩しいってもんだ
findings.governingReading: that freedom and trust look a little dazzling to someone unable to betray his own Master lightly
findings.explanation: The English invents direct praise of Rin as a Master and omits Lancer’s wistful distance from the freedom he is witnessing.

findings.highlight: but I’m not one that can readily betray my Master.
findings.evidenceJa: おいそれと主を裏切れない身としちゃあ、少しばかり眩しい
findings.governingReading: to one in my position, unable lightly to betray his Master, it is a little dazzling
findings.explanation: The loyalty clause is left as an unrelated self-description rather than the reason Rin’s gratitude and their alliance appear dazzling.
